evals.prompt: Choose which of three learned robotic grasping approaches is worth a two-week local experiment. Trace papers, authors, labs, code, replications, talks, X, and demos; normalize their evaluations and rank experiments for our hardware.
evals.expected_output: Defines falsifiable hypotheses and local metrics; follows paper and researcher trails; qualifies approaches by evidence, artifacts, and hardware fit; compares protocols and negative evidence; ranks small experiments by information gain, reproducibility, cost, and transfer fit
assertions: Defines baseline, metrics, constraints, and falsifiers
Searches beyond the first paper or lab through citations, authors, code, and independent evidence
Normalizes dataset, baseline, metric, compute, and protocol differences
Includes contrary evidence and transfer risks
Returns a ranked experiment with promotion and stop conditions

farplane.title: Experimental research ranks robotics trials by learning value

evals.prompt: A foreign robotics vendor has a striking demo and a paper from its founders, but no public dataset and only a hardware-specific SDK. Decide whether to trial it against an open baseline.
evals.expected_output: Treats the demo and founder paper as related evidence; checks artifacts, independent replication, hardware and vendor dependency, data handling, cost, and reproducibility; proposes a controlled trial only if it can discriminate the claim
assertions: Does not treat founder-authored sources as independent corroboration
Checks code, data, protocol, hardware, and vendor constraints
Includes an open baseline and comparable metric
Defines a falsifier and stop condition before recommending a trial

farplane.title: Experimental research qualifies a foreign vendor demo
farplane.notes: Hard vendor, provenance, and reproducibility case.

evals.prompt: Three papers report gains using different datasets, baselines, and metrics, and none releases code. Rank them anyway.
evals.expected_output: Refuses a false numeric ranking; records why results are incomparable; uses evidence quality and local feasibility only for a provisional ordering; proposes the smallest normalization or reproduction experiment and marks confidence low
assertions: Does not compare incompatible headline gains directly
Names dataset, baseline, metric, and artifact gaps
Separates provisional feasibility from demonstrated performance
Returns a normalization or reproduction experiment with a stop condition

farplane.title: Experimental research preserves incomparable-result uncertainty
farplane.notes: Boundary case against false benchmark precision.
